name: Immovrel
description: Immovrel is a precision immune modulator designed for heavily augmented individuals whose immune systems have been destabilized by extensive chrome, SNT implants, and geneware — a condition called augment-induced immune dysregulation (AIID). It recalibrates immune response thresholds to tolerate high augment loads while preserving the ability to fight genuine pathogens, a balance that standard immunosuppressants like Toleryn cannot achieve at high augmentation levels.
effects: recalibrates immune tolerance for high augment loads
maintains pathogen-fighting capacity despite augment tolerance
reduces systemic inflammation in heavily augmented patients
stabilizes autoimmune responses triggered by SNT interfaces
side_effects: two-week recalibration period with flu-like symptoms
rare severe allergic response to the modulator proteins themselves
requires precise dosing — over-modulation leaves patients vulnerable to infection
cultural_context: Immovrel is for the seriously augmented — people whose chrome load is high enough that standard Toleryn alone can't manage the immune chaos. Tier 3 workers with extensive labor augments often need it by their forties. Tier 4 corporate soldiers with military-grade installs need it from day one. The monthly injection is a ritual in augment-heavy communities. On the Shelf, people who need Immovrel and can't afford it develop AIID — a slow inflammatory death.
story_hooks: A Helix Biosystems researcher has discovered that Immovrel's modulation proteins can be tuned to make the immune system attack specific augment types — a biological weapon disguised as medicine
A character with extensive chrome is developing AIID symptoms despite regular Immovrel — their augments are generating a novel inflammatory signal the drug wasn't designed to handle
The monthly Immovrel injection for a Tier 3 community has been quietly discontinued — Helix is redirecting supply to a more profitable Tier 4 contract
